system.description: As long as you’re not currently fighting them (e.g. you’re at war), you can turn even the most bitter of enemies into family. This requires a long-term project—6 segments to turn them into a crew contact, 10 segments to turn them into a cohort or PC (your choice). If they become a PC, create them as normal, with bonus action dots and abilities each equal to their Tier, and any deadlocks at the GM’s discretion. Their faction’s relationship to your crew does not change.
